Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Glenwood Modern Industrial Metal Base Dining Room Table, 78"L, Oak Wood
Colors: Oak
Materials: stone
This handsome modern table combines an attractive wood top with an industrial-style metal base. Simple, clean lines and beautiful quarter-sawn oak veneer finish make this piece look at home in rustic or modern settings. 78"L x 40"D x 30"H Hardwood table top with quarter-sawn oak veneer and metal base A simple modern piece with rustic and industrial influences Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Assembly is required. Wipe with soft dry cloth.
